h1: How do landmark designation rules work for historic homes in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Historic Landmark Rules: Exterior Work and Approval
description: Learn when a Newton City Landmark or preservation-restricted property needs historic approval before exterior work.
short_answer: A Newton City Landmark requires historic review before exterior work begins. A property with a Preservation Restriction also requires review under the terms of that restriction. The required approval and design standards depend on the individual property's designation and the scope of the proposed work.

facts.text: Newton requires a Local Landmark Review Application for changes to a designated City Landmark, with Historical Commission approval before exterior work begins.
Newton says the terms of each Preservation Restriction specify what work may or may not be allowed and require review before exterior work.

qa.q: Does landmark approval replace a building permit?
qa.a: No. Historic approval and building permits are separate approvals. Newton says a historic certificate is necessary but not sufficient for a building permit.
